definitions.purpose: Diagnostic comparison of known cases only; no proposed or tested classification rule.
definitions.values: pawn90 knight300 bishop300 rook500 queen1000; these material units are not engine centipawns.
definitions.baseline: Original pre-move material balance from mover perspective, including immediate capture credit.
definitions.horizons: Root move is ply1. Report plies1,2,3,4,6,12 plus full saved PV; unavailable horizons are null.
definitions.caveat: PV ledger is one predicted line, not forced material loss. Minima can be unreciprocated exchange steps. A nonterminal endpoint is truncated; terminal mate does not measure permanent material cost.
definitions.acceptances: Previously saved conditional lines only; played move + acceptance + saved reply PV. Missing acceptance searches remain missing.
definitions.comparison: Current and previous complete depth windows retained. Constrained/unrestricted searches have different contexts; do not treat small evaluation differences as exact opportunity costs.
definitions.selection: All19 cases retained, including contradictions. No threshold, refit, global validation or rating analysis.
